items.text:
The ACA Marketplace enrollment window opens on November 1. The people who have the easiest time are the ones who gathered a few things beforehand.

What to have ready:

- Your best estimate of household income for next year. Subsidies are based on that estimate, not on last year's tax return, so if your income is changing, say so.
- A list of your doctors and the hospital you would use. Networks differ by plan, and in Northern Virginia they can differ by county.
- Every prescription you take, by name.
- Your current plan's details, so you can tell whether staying is the better choice.

Compare total cost, not just the monthly premium. A lower premium can come with a higher deductible, and the difference shows up when you use care.

We do this comparison for individuals, families and the self-employed across Northern Virginia, at no cost to you.

Honorbrook Insurance. (571) 354-0146 honorbrook-insurance.com
